You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From 26ea7484ee8203e3f2985d3496980404d42435ae Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: vigorouscoding <kai.schwaiger@structr.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Feb 2017 17:28:25 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] Bugfix: Correctly respects configuration switch
 `application.filesystem.unique.paths` when renaming files/folders (bug
 introduced in commit 1e8d8cd)

---
 .../src/main/java/org/structr/web/entity/AbstractFile.java | 7 ++++++-
 1 file changed, 6 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/structr-ui/src/main/java/org/structr/web/entity/AbstractFile.java b/structr-ui/src/main/java/org/structr/web/entity/AbstractFile.java
index 5bb005d964..ab8131d117 100644
--- a/structr-ui/src/main/java/org/structr/web/entity/AbstractFile.java
+++ b/structr-ui/src/main/java/org/structr/web/entity/AbstractFile.java
@@ -92,7 +92,12 @@ public class AbstractFile extends LinkedTreeNode<FileChildren, FileSiblings, Abs
 	@Override
 	public boolean onModification(final SecurityContext securityContext, final ErrorBuffer errorBuffer, final ModificationQueue modificationQueue) throws FrameworkException {
 
-		final boolean valid = validatePath(securityContext, errorBuffer);
+		boolean valid = true;
+
+		if (validatePathUniqueness) {
+			valid = validatePath(securityContext, errorBuffer);
+		}
+
 		return valid && super.onModification(securityContext, errorBuffer, modificationQueue);
 	}
 
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by a failure to respect the configuration switch `application.filesystem.unique.paths` when renaming files/folders, which was not properly implemented in the method modifying file paths. Specifically, in the original code, the path uniqueness was always validated without checking the configuration switch, leading to incorrect behavior during file operations that involve renaming.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by a failure to respect the configuration switch `application.filesystem.unique.paths` when renaming files/folders, which was not properly implemented in the method modifying file paths. Specifically, in the original code, the path uniqueness was always validated without checking the configuration switch, leading to incorrect behavior during file operations that involve renaming.
